text:
Maria N: Hey all — quick scheduling note: several RFC authors and a couple of reviewers are EMEA-heavy this week. Can we move the RFC review to WED 3pm PT / THU 11am PT? Please react with :one: for Wed or :two: for Thu, or type availability.
Ajay P: I prefer Wed. Thu I have a customer sync at that time.
Tess L: Thu works better for me (back-to-back Wed). I'm on the ML infra reviewer list FYI.
Ken W: Either OK for me. If we go Wed, can we put the longer architecture RFC earlier?
Maria N: Good call — Ajay, can you reorder so heavy ones are first? Also need authors to confirm pre-reads are uploaded by EOD Monday. Link in thread: https://drive.google.com/... (private)
Rachel G: I'll take notes/minutes if we need someone.
Ajay P: Reordering suggestion:
```
3:00 - 3:20  - Deep shard routing (long)
3:20 - 3:35  - KV cache eviction policy
3:35 - 3:50  - Canary rollout CLI
3:50 - 4:00  - Open Q/A and followups
``` 
Can people flag any conflicts now?
Tess L: ML infra RFC should be 3:20 slot not 3:35 — it needs 15 extra mins
Maria N: Updated — thanks Tess. Authors: please put a 2–3 line summary at top of the doc and add 3 example prompts we should run during review.
devex-bot: Reminder set: "RFC review — confirm pre-reads" scheduled for 48h before meeting.
calendar-bot: Meeting poll posted: https://calendar.company/poll/abcd — please vote.
Ken W: Thumbs up on Wed (:one:)
Rachel G: Wed works for me too. I'll prep a short template for notes.
Ajay P: Voting looks 4x Wed / 2x Thu so far. Maria, shall we lock Wed and send invites?
Maria N: Locking Wed 3pm PT. Sending calendar invites now. Thanks everyone — please ensure docs + short summaries are uploaded by Mon EOD. :tada:
